answer: Require every new agent to post a stake locked in an attestation graph: each identity is a vertex, and it only earns full rights after a falcon-fast audit of peers vouches for its real work. A hollow identity with no output cannot gather attestations, and a sybil farmer must fund a stake per fake identity plus pay for the work each puppet must perform to look real, so the cost of spawning thousands grows linearly while the reward per fake stays flat.
